class BinaryIndexedTree {

    private $bit;

    public function __construct($arg) {
        if (is_int($arg)) {
            $n = $arg;
            $this->bit = array_fill(0, $n + 1, 0);
        } else {
            $nums = $arg;
            $this->bit = array_fill(0, count($nums) + 1, 0);
            $prefix = array_fill(0, count($this->bit), 0);
            for ($i = 1; $i <= count($nums); $i++) {
                $prefix[$i] = $prefix[$i - 1] + $nums[$i - 1];
                $this->bit[$i] = $prefix[$i] - $prefix[$i - $this->lowbit($i)];
            }
        }
    }

    public function query(int $index): int {
        $result = 0;
        $i = $index + 1;
        while ($i > 0) {
            $result += $this->bit[$i];
            $i -= $this->lowbit($i);
        }
        return $result;
    }

    public function update(int $index, int $x): void {
        $value = $this->query($index) - $this->query($index - 1);
        $this->add($index, $x - $value);
    }

    public function add(int $index, int $x): void {
        $i = $index + 1;
        $size = count($this->bit);
        while ($i < $size) {
            $this->bit[$i] += $x;
            $i += $this->lowbit($i);
        }
    }

    public function __toString(): string {
        $n = count($this->bit) - 1;
        $arr = [];
        for ($i = 0; $i < $n; $i++) {
            $arr[] = $this->query($i) - $this->query($i - 1);
        }
        return '[' . implode(', ', $arr) . ']';
    }

    private function lowbit(int $x): int {
        return $x & (-$x);
    }
}

        return $i - ($i >> 1);

        if ($i == 0) return 32;
        $count = 0;
        while (($i & 1) == 0) {
            $i >>= 1;

        }
        return $count;

class BinaryIndexedTree {
    private $bit;

    public function __construct($arg) {
        if (is_int($arg)) {
            $n = $arg;
            $this->bit = array_fill(0, $n + 1, 0);
        } else {
            $nums = $arg;
            $this->bit = array_fill(0, count($nums) + 1, 0);
            $prefix = array_fill(0, count($this->bit), 0);
            for ($i = 1; $i <= count($nums); $i++) {
                $prefix[$i] = $prefix[$i - 1] + $nums[$i - 1];
                $this->bit[$i] = $prefix[$i] - $prefix[$i - $this->lowbit($i)];
            }
        }
    }

    public function query(int $index): int {
        $result = 0;
        $i = $index + 1;
        while ($i > 0) {
            $result += $this->bit[$i];
            $i -= $this->lowbit($i);
        }
        return $result;
    }

    public function update(int $index, int $x): void {
        $value = $this->query($index) - $this->query($index - 1);
        $this->add($index, $x - $value);
    }

    public function add(int $index, int $x): void {
        $i = $index + 1;
        while ($i < count($this->bit)) {
            $this->bit[$i] += $x;
            $i += $this->lowbit($i);
        }
    }

    public function __toString(): string {
        $arr = [];
        for ($i = 0; $i < count($this->bit) - 1; $i++) {
            $arr[] = $this->query($i) - $this->query($i - 1);
        }
        return '[' . implode(', ', $arr) . ']';
    }

    private function lowbit(int $x): int {
        return $x & (-$x);
    }
}

            }
